notes.title: Update v1.08 - Windows ONLY - crash reporting system
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

from time to time we get reports that game crashes on the launch or at some point and usually it's quite tedious to catch the bug without proper information.

I'm happy to announce that we have integrated crash reporting system in Zotrix.

In general if your game crashes, game will generate 3 files in the same folder where your main executable file is:

 OceanMedia-Crash-Instructions.txt

 OceanMedia-CrashReport.txt
 OceanMedia-CrashDump.dmp


First file on the list is obvious, describes what to do in this case.
Other two files is what we need and just simply email them to support@oceanmedia.hr and we'll take it from there.

This will help us a lot to improve the game and cure terminal bugs.

Vedran Klanac,
creator of Zotrix

notes.title: Update v0.06 - added new languages FR, ES, IT, DE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we are all very excited here at ZeroBit Games as today is very important milestone for us.

Zotrix is released to four new languages including French, Spanish, Italian and German!

We have been working on this in background for last couple of months together with
our translators who did great job.

I would like to thank once again to following people who helped with their great contribution.

French localization:
translation - Romain Galati
proofreading - Sunny Singhasiri and Nicolas Gourdon

Spanish localization:
Eduardo L. Arana

Italian localization:
Riccardo Di Maio

German localization:
Dário Krobath

Support for multiple languages is added through Options menu, where player is able to click on the flag to enter language selection screen and change the language.

We have couple of more languages in the works and hope to release them in the near future.

Best regards,
Vedran Klanac
creator of Zotrix

notes.title: Update v0.05 - adjusted game economy
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

in today's major update we are bringing following changes to the game:

 reworked game economy and trading system, it is more balanced now and allows less exploits
 redesigned number of arcade levels which were hurdle for many players
 adjusted control scheme and responsivness for gamepad controller on arcade levels
 navigation in menus using gamepad now uses D-Pad (finally)
 added "skip intro" button to lower right corner during Intro sequence


Focus for the update was on rebalancing the game economy and trading system which should make game more interesting.

There has been number of ideas and suggestions related to game balancing on the discussion forums and I would like to use this opportunity to thank all the players who contributed with their ideas.

happy shooting,
Vedran Klanac
creator of Zotrix

notes.title: Update v0.04 - Steam Leaderboards added
notes.notes:
This update is bringing one new feature to the game and that's Steam Leaderboards.

Leaderbaords are added, one for each mission, so now you can compete and see how good you are in each mission comparing to other players.

You can access leaderboards from Mission Control screen. 
You will notice one new button right below Tutorial button at the Mission Control screen.

Post mission dialog also got updated and now you are able to see your mission stats, score table for that mission and you are able to choose if you want to replay the mission right away or continue further on.

On another note, I wanted to let you know we are carefully collecting your feedback which is coming in recent weeks about balancing issues.

Next update will deal with those issues and we will take into account number of your suggestions while addressing the balancing matrix equipment store vs trading vs mission rewards.

Thanks again for all the feedback you are sending to us, it is very valuable and helpful.

Best Regards,
Vedran Klanac
creator of Zotrix

notes.title: Patch v0.02 - gamepad controller issues addressed
notes.notes:
We have just released patch v0.02 for PC, Mac and Linux builds. 

Major part that we were addressing with this patch is poor end user experience
when it comes to configuring your gamepad controller as well as
sluggish and not intuitive control of the ship on the arcade level.

There is no need anymore for configuration screen because game now auto detects your
gamepad controller and its button and axis mappings.

Focus was on primarily supporting X360 and compatible controllers.
We are aware there might be controllers which might not work.

This patch is addressing following issues: 

Removed gamepad configuration screen
Gameapd controller mapping auto detection system integrated
Default gamepad mapping is set for X360 controller
Fixed crash when entering Equipment Store in Linux and Mac versions
Nuke destroying the cargo ship issue fixed
Losing a life when losing a decoy bug fixed
Boss HealthBar length issue fixed
Decoy destroying the boss by drain bug fixed
Wrong route descriptions on the Entropy station bug fixed.
Help message on the Armory screen on how to add/remove items to the weapon slot has been adjusted.


Instead reporting each separate case with controller issues, I will pin discussion point, so please if anything you need to report in regards the issues related to gamepad controller report it there.

This way it is much easier to track the issues and we will have all information in one place. This will allow us to better understand all the issues and to fix them properly.

Vedran Klanac
Creator of Zotrix

notes.title: Patch v0.01
notes.notes:
We have just released patch v0.01 for PC, Mac and Linux builds.

This patch is addressing following issues:


 fixes issue with oversensitive dead zones for gamepad - this should help the game controls working much better (especially Logitec F310 and X360 controllers)
 allows text being skipped on mouse click or gamepad button press, during quest and mission presentation
 fixes bug with endless arcade levels
 disables "Test Ride" under Equipment Store until we fix properly the bug with vanishing equipment, at least this way you won't be able to lose them
 minor spelling errors fixed in mission descriptions


We are aware of the issues with gamepad controllers and this patch should improve the behavior.

We are not happy with gamepad configuration screen as it is too complex and it's not straight forward. We are working this week on redesign of the sequence to make it much better for a player.

Thanks guys for reporting issues, we are listening to all what you encounter and are actively adding those to our task list.

This is it for now, stay tuned for further updates.

Vedran Klanac
creator of Zotrix

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Full gamepad support
notes.notes:
We have been busy in the last couple of weeks with integrating new features.

The big thing we have for today is full support for the gamepad controllers!

With this feature you can now fully enjoy playing the game in Big Picture Mode, where available.

Under the Options menu you are now able to switch your controls between:

mouse + keyboard
gamepad contoller


Next to gamepad controller you will notice new "Settings" button which will take you to
full gamepad configuration screen.

Gamepad configuration screen allows you to map your gamepad buttons the way you want.
It also allows you to configure your analog axes and it will detect dead zones for each axis.

Default button and analog axes mapping is based on Xbox 360 controller. 

We have tested controllers from various other manufacturers and they worked just fine, once configured within the game.

change log for build v0.06:

added gamepad configuration screen
changed fire mechanic for gamepad controller to be more intuitive
at MissionControl screen renamed button "Upgrades" to "Equipment Store"
equipment items in Station Store are now showing if they are "permanent upgrade" or "expendable equipment"
game is prepared for localization to other languages


We are working on remaining of the content for the game. Once that is finalized we are going into Full Release.
This is planned to happen finally in July and the whole team is quite excited about this.

Stay tuned!

Zotrix Development Team

notes.title: Roadmap to Full Release and beyond
notes.notes:
It's been now exactly 1 month since we released the game on Early Access. 

Our general idea was to get response from community and overall to make a better game.

We wanted to figure out in what direction to go with the features or storyline, should we have more story, or less, should we lean towards arcade missions only or adding more juice with other features and things like that. 

In other words, we wanted to get a sense what is the right mix for this game.

Up to this point we have released 6 updates with various fixes and features based on the active feedback from you guys.

That’s what we plan to do in the future as well.

We have gathered a lot of feedback which came to us via discussion forums, direct emails and most of it on private chat here on Steam.

After analyzing all that, we came up with roadmap for full release of this game and what would happen next.

Before game converts to full release two more updates are planned, #7 and #8.

Update #7 (ETA by end of March 2015)
linux version of the game

Update #8 (ETA by mid April 2015)
full gamepad configuration / calibration settings
keyboard key mapping settings

Full Release (ETA by end of April 2015)

We will be adding additional layer of depth in the game, and we plan to do that by introducing quests.

Quests are actual high level goals for a player to accomplish in order to get some kind of reward. 

What’s more important, quests will be story driven where more active role is given to Space Station Commanders.
There will be new section on every Space Station where you will be able to check status of active quests and monitor your progress.

The whole idea around quests is that if you want to follow the story you can do so and go in specific order accomplish quest by quest, if you want just to play arcade game, you can pick your own course through the game and play it that way.

When we decided to introduce quests, next natural step is to tie them with rewards which will come in form of Steam Achievements. 

Routes between stations will stay as they are except arcade missions itself will be redesigned to extent to avoid such repetition as it is noticed right now.

During this final stage we have decided to start localizing game into other languages and we are doing that with great help from the community.

So far we plan to cover following languages for full release:

Russian
Chinese
German
Polish
Spanish
Turkish
Hrvatski
Bosanski
Arabic


It is possible that some of these languages won’t be available in the version which is called “full release” as we depend on availability of translators, but we will make sure these languages become available via updates which will follow after the release.

There are more languages we plan to cover in future updates, languages we listed above are the ones where we have arranged and organized people who will help us. We are still looking for volunteers to help us cover other languages. 

To summarize all the new elements we will introduce to full release of the game:

full content as planned in start with total of 60 arcade missions / routes
quests system with over 60 quests
refreshed arcade missions
Steam Achievements
additional languages


What happens after full release?

Our plan is to release at least one DLC by August 2015 and hopefully another one by November 2015.

That will depend on many factors but mainly on resources available on our end because...

...there is new game we are working on, Solar Division, and that game is heavily related to Zotrix. 

There will be an interesting interaction between these two games.

Stay tuned and thanks a lot for the support and feedback, it means a world to us.

Zotrix Development Team

notes.title: Update #4 - drones and gamepad controller
notes.notes:
In today's update following changes to the game have been made: 	
- integrated Drones, finally :) you can find them in Upgrade store and attach to your ship on "Arm Your Ship" screen
- fixed number of issues with initializing screen resolution, however we are aware some issues still exist, if anyone encounters on something strange, please let us know
- soft launch for gamepad controller support, featuring limited support at this point (see notes below)
- added option to select controller type under options menu
- added help screen for gamepad controls along with existing help screen for keyboard and mouse controls - accessed via F1 during game level
- added helper calculation of your trading amount above the entry field (so you don't need calculator on a side)
- stabilized economy of resources within trading system
- fixed bug with boss enemy where you would get over 2 Billion of credits and enter into negative range

About gamepad controller support at this point:
- gamepad controls are modelled based on X360 controller and are mapped for it
- game recognizes gamepad controller which MUST be connected before you start the game
- game still doesn't recognize connect/disconnect events -> that is in the works and will come up in one of the following updates
- within the game level, pressing Y button on controller or F1 on keyboard will bring up help screen for the controls
- there is no customization screen for controls -> we expect to have it ready by the date game goes in full release

Zotrix Development Team
